skills.title: RBAC role hierarchy and least privilege
skills.objective: Understand roles, users, grants, ownership, inheritance, and least-privilege access design.
exam_traps: Confusing functional roles with access roles.
Forgetting that ownership transfer can revoke existing outbound privileges unless handled carefully.
Granting broad privileges directly to users instead of roles.

skills.title: Network policies and authentication controls
skills.objective: Recognize account security controls including MFA, network policy, SSO, and authentication choices.
exam_traps: Mixing account-level policy behavior with user-level overrides.

skills.title: Warehouse sizing, suspend/resume, and cost control
skills.objective: Choose warehouse size, auto-suspend, auto-resume, scaling, and cost guardrails.
exam_traps: Assuming a larger warehouse always reduces cost.
Forgetting idle warehouses continue billing until suspended.
Confusing multi-cluster scaling with scaling up the warehouse size.

skills.title: Query history and performance troubleshooting
skills.objective: Use history views and query profile signals to diagnose performance and cost.
exam_traps: Confusing result cache, metadata cache, and warehouse cache behavior.

skills.title: Stages, file formats, and COPY INTO
skills.objective: Create stages/file formats and load structured files using COPY INTO with validation.
exam_traps: Forgetting file formats can be named objects reused by stages and COPY statements.
Confusing internal, external, table, and user stages.

skills.title: Snowpipe and continuous loading
skills.objective: Understand Snowpipe auto-ingest, notifications, pipe objects, and load history.
exam_traps: Assuming Snowpipe uses your user warehouse like COPY INTO does.

skills.title: VARIANT, JSON pathing, and FLATTEN
skills.objective: Store JSON in VARIANT, query nested paths, and flatten arrays into rows.
exam_traps: Forgetting FLATTEN is table-function style and commonly used with LATERAL.
Mixing string casting and numeric casting from VARIANT paths.

skills.title: Time Travel, Fail-safe, and zero-copy clone
skills.objective: Recover objects, query historical data, understand retention, and use zero-copy cloning.
exam_traps: Confusing Time Travel recovery with Fail-safe, which is not user self-service.

skills.title: Secure data sharing and governance controls
skills.objective: Understand shares, reader accounts, masking, row access, tags, and marketplace concepts.
exam_traps: Confusing secure data sharing with copying or unloading data.

skills.title: Streams and tasks for incremental pipelines
skills.objective: Use streams to track change data and tasks to automate processing.
exam_traps: Forgetting a stream offset advances when stream rows are consumed successfully.

skills.title: Account, organization, and environment strategy
skills.objective: Design account structures, environments, naming, region strategy, and separation of duties for enterprise Snowflake platforms.
exam_traps: Using one account for every workload can make governance and blast radius harder.
Confusing database replication with full account failover.

skills.title: Network connectivity and private access
skills.objective: Design secure connectivity using network policies, PrivateLink/private connectivity, and controlled client access.
exam_traps: Network policy is not the same as private connectivity.
Private connectivity still needs identity and role controls.

skills.title: Data governance, tagging, masking, and classification
skills.objective: Apply object tagging, masking policies, row access policies, classification, and governance patterns at scale.
exam_traps: A masking policy protects columns, while row access policies filter rows.
Tags are metadata and need policies/processes to enforce behavior.

skills.title: Enterprise RBAC model and ownership strategy
skills.objective: Design scalable functional roles, access roles, ownership, managed access schemas, and grant patterns.
exam_traps: Ownership grants are powerful and often misunderstood.
Future grants behave differently across databases and schemas.

skills.title: Data modeling and workload-aligned storage
skills.objective: Design database/schema layout, transient/temporary/permanent objects, clustering strategy, and data lifecycle patterns.
exam_traps: Clustering is not always beneficial; it must match pruning needs.
Transient tables reduce fail-safe but change recovery expectations.

skills.title: Secure data sharing and marketplace architecture
skills.objective: Use shares, listings, reader accounts, provider/consumer patterns, and cross-account data products.
exam_traps: A share does not copy data.
Reader accounts are for consumers without their own Snowflake account.

skills.title: Performance architecture and workload isolation
skills.objective: Design warehouse patterns, workload isolation, query acceleration, search optimization, and performance monitoring.
exam_traps: Scaling up and scaling out solve different performance problems.
Search optimization has cost and use-case boundaries.

skills.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery
skills.objective: Design replication, failover, retention, Time Travel, Fail-safe, backup, and DR operating procedures.
exam_traps: Time Travel is not a substitute for full DR design.
Fail-safe is not user-controlled recovery.

skills.title: Enterprise cost controls and observability
skills.objective: Implement resource monitors, budgets, query attribution, chargeback/showback, and operational dashboards.
exam_traps: Resource monitors notify/suspend warehouses but do not optimize SQL automatically.
Cost attribution requires tagging and query/user context.

skills.title: Batch loading with stages, file formats, and COPY INTO
skills.objective: Build reliable batch ingestion from internal/external stages using file formats, COPY options, validation, and load history.
exam_traps: COPY INTO loads from stages, not directly from arbitrary client folders.
ON_ERROR behavior can hide or surface bad files depending on settings.

skills.title: Continuous ingestion with Snowpipe and notifications
skills.objective: Design Snowpipe auto-ingest and notification patterns for near-real-time file loading.
exam_traps: Snowpipe is serverless ingestion, not a transformation engine.
Cloud notifications must be configured outside the pipe definition too.

skills.title: Streams and Tasks for incremental pipelines
skills.objective: Use streams, task graphs, change tracking, and scheduled/serverless tasks for incremental processing.
exam_traps: Streams track change records; they are not a permanent history table.
Tasks need a schedule or predecessor and proper warehouse/serverless settings.

skills.title: Dynamic tables and declarative pipelines
skills.objective: Use dynamic tables, target lag, refresh modes, and pipeline dependencies where appropriate.
exam_traps: Dynamic tables are not identical to materialized views.
Target lag affects freshness and compute usage.

skills.title: SQL transformation quality and error handling
skills.objective: Design transformations with idempotency, validation, deduplication, error handling, and auditability.
exam_traps: MERGE keys must be stable or you can duplicate/change rows incorrectly.
Deduplication logic should be deterministic.

skills.title: Query optimization and micro-partition pruning
skills.objective: Optimize SQL using pruning, clustering awareness, query profile, result cache, and warehouse sizing.
exam_traps: Clustering does not fix every slow query.
Result cache can make tests misleading if you ignore cache behavior.

skills.title: Semi-structured data engineering
skills.objective: Process JSON, arrays, VARIANT, FLATTEN, lateral joins, and schema-on-read patterns.
exam_traps: FLATTEN expands rows and can multiply data volume quickly.
Casting VARIANT fields is often required for joins and filters.

skills.title: Snowpark Python data pipelines
skills.objective: Use Snowpark DataFrames, functions, UDFs, stored procedures, packages, and deployment patterns.
exam_traps: Snowpark pushes work to Snowflake; it is not meant to pull all data to the client.
Package availability and runtime versions matter.

skills.title: Pipeline monitoring and operational recovery
skills.objective: Monitor load/query/task history, failures, retries, alerts, and operational recovery.
exam_traps: ACCOUNT_USAGE can have latency; INFORMATION_SCHEMA is often more immediate.
Retries without idempotency can duplicate data.

skills.title: Sessions, DataFrames, and lazy execution
skills.objective: Use Snowpark sessions, DataFrame operations, lazy execution, and SQL pushdown concepts.
exam_traps: Calling collect brings data back to the client.
DataFrame code is lazily evaluated until an action runs.

skills.title: SQL and DataFrame interoperability
skills.objective: Combine SQL, DataFrame APIs, temp views, and Snowflake functions effectively.
exam_traps: Mixing local Python logic with Snowflake execution can create performance surprises.

skills.title: UDF and UDTF development
skills.objective: Create and deploy scalar UDFs and table functions with correct types, imports, packages, and handlers.
exam_traps: Handlers must match declared input/output types.
Package dependencies must be available in Snowflake runtime.

skills.title: Stored procedures and task integration
skills.objective: Build stored procedures that operate on data and can be scheduled/orchestrated in Snowflake.
exam_traps: Stored procedures need explicit return types and deployment context.

skills.title: Feature engineering with Snowpark
skills.objective: Prepare data, create features, split datasets, and support ML workflows inside Snowflake.
exam_traps: Feature generation should be reproducible and avoid leakage.

skills.title: Model inference and deployment patterns
skills.objective: Apply models, batch inference, model registry concepts, and operational patterns in Snowflake.
exam_traps: Training/inference location affects data movement and governance.

skills.title: Snowpark performance and scaling
skills.objective: Optimize Snowpark code by minimizing client-side operations, understanding pushdown, and tuning warehouses.
exam_traps: to_pandas/collect can accidentally move large data out of Snowflake.

skills.title: Packaging, versioning, and CI/CD for Snowpark
skills.objective: Manage packages, imports, stages, versioning, deployment, and environment reproducibility.
exam_traps: Local package behavior may differ from Snowflake runtime availability.

skills.title: Secure execution and role-aware development
skills.objective: Use roles, warehouses, secrets, external access, and governance controls for Snowpark workloads.
exam_traps: External access requires network rules/integrations and should be tightly scoped.

skills.title: Cortex LLM functions and prompt design
skills.objective: Use COMPLETE, SUMMARIZE, TRANSLATE, EXTRACT_ANSWER, sentiment, and prompt patterns responsibly.
exam_traps: LLM functions can produce non-deterministic outputs.
Prompts should include context boundaries and expected format.

skills.title: AI SQL integration patterns
skills.objective: Apply Cortex functions inside SQL pipelines while managing cost, quality, and repeatability.
exam_traps: Calling LLM functions row-by-row can be expensive.

skills.title: Cortex Search service design
skills.objective: Create and use search services, choose search columns, understand refresh, and retrieve relevant chunks.
exam_traps: Search quality depends heavily on chunking and selected columns.

skills.title: RAG grounding and citation patterns
skills.objective: Build retrieval-augmented generation with grounded context, source citations, and hallucination controls.
exam_traps: A model answer without retrieved evidence should be treated as low confidence.

skills.title: Document AI extraction workflows
skills.objective: Use Document AI-style extraction and validation patterns for PDFs/forms/unstructured sources.
exam_traps: Extraction needs validation and human review for critical workflows.

skills.title: Chunking and preprocessing for GenAI
skills.objective: Prepare documents with chunking, metadata, cleaning, and structure for search/RAG quality.
exam_traps: Bad chunking can break even a strong model.

skills.title: AI governance and secure data use
skills.objective: Apply masking, RBAC, access controls, prompt safety, and data governance to GenAI workloads.
exam_traps: LLM access does not bypass Snowflake privileges.
Prompt injection and data leakage risks must be controlled.

skills.title: AI evaluation, monitoring, and cost control
skills.objective: Evaluate quality, monitor usage/cost, test regressions, and track model behavior.
exam_traps: A demo answer is not enough; use repeatable evaluations.

skills.title: GenAI application patterns in Snowflake
skills.objective: Design AI assistants, summarizers, classifiers, and analytics copilots using governed Snowflake data.
exam_traps: Application UX must expose confidence and sources.

skills.title: Warehouse right-sizing and auto-suspend
skills.objective: Tune warehouse size, scaling, auto-suspend, auto-resume, and workload isolation for cost/performance.
exam_traps: Larger warehouse can finish faster but not always cheaper.
Idle time is a common hidden cost.

skills.title: Resource monitors, budgets, and alerts
skills.objective: Configure monitors, budgets, alerts, thresholds, and suspend actions to control credit burn.
exam_traps: Monitors are guardrails, not query optimizers.

skills.title: Query profile, pruning, and scanning reduction
skills.objective: Use query profile, partition pruning, clustering, and SQL rewrites to reduce scan/compute cost.
exam_traps: Clustering adds maintenance cost; measure benefit first.

skills.title: Caching, result reuse, and warehouse behavior
skills.objective: Understand result cache, local disk cache, metadata cache, and when queries consume compute.
exam_traps: Cached results can hide true workload cost during testing.

skills.title: Storage, retention, Time Travel, and Fail-safe cost
skills.objective: Optimize table type, retention period, clone behavior, Time Travel, and storage lifecycle.
exam_traps: Transient tables reduce fail-safe but change recovery guarantees.
Zero-copy clone shares storage until changes diverge.

skills.title: File sizing and loading efficiency
skills.objective: Use appropriate file sizes, compression, stages, and load patterns to reduce ingestion overhead.
exam_traps: Too many tiny files can hurt loading efficiency.

skills.title: ACCOUNT_USAGE cost attribution
skills.objective: Use metering history, query history, tags, warehouses, users, and roles for chargeback/showback.
exam_traps: ACCOUNT_USAGE latency can delay reporting.
Without tags/context, chargeback is guesswork.

skills.title: Cost alerting and automated remediation
skills.objective: Build alerts/tasks around spend spikes, idle warehouses, and anomalous usage.
exam_traps: Automation should avoid breaking critical workloads without escalation.

skills.title: FinOps operating model for Snowflake
skills.objective: Define ownership, tagging, budgets, usage reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
exam_traps: Technical controls fail without ownership and review cadence.
